best.explanation: Lagide looks like a fun-sized window for Fun progression, Medium confidence: 0.9-1.2 m, 157 kJ, 10 s period, consistent 70/100, and wind is the main risk.  A dependable left-hand reef that turns modest swell into real rides; this is best for clean, playful walls when the bigger beaches are too wild or too small; 10-13s at mid tide suits the reef shelves and gives long workable walls.  Watch: wind angle is poor for this spot.
